node.title: Re: utf8 for require scripts
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
A bisect confirms the change is due to the fixing of bug [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/issues/11541|RT#96008] in [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/639dfab029654a3b066df400686e1acdaae62762|639dfab]: before v5.16.0, [doc://use] and [doc://require] were affected by the [https://perldoc.perl.org/open.html|open] pragma. Since your index_req.pl is apparently encoded in UTF-8, it does require a use utf8; at the top, because that's basically what the [doc://utf8] pragma means: "this lexical block is encoded in UTF-8".

Sorry, but the best practice here is to put the use utf8; pragma at the top of every Perl source file that is encoded in UTF-8, everything else is a hack, or workaround at best.
